text:
alice.h: Heads-up — release window in ~2h for 0.32.0. Need to confirm who is allowed to press prod in case we need a quick rollback. Also noticed MFA enrollment showing some contractor accounts as unverified. Anyone aware of a short-term backfill plan?
ben_k: who currently has the "release-press" role? last I checked it was 2x release eng + oncall.
chloe: System shows three active principals: alice.h, ben_k, marco. Contract contractors are in a separate grp but some haven't completed MFA.
marco: I'm on the roster but my YubiKey got lost last week; I filed a replacement request but still waiting. Can someone with perms press if needed?
alice.h: @deploy-bot can we get a quick list of principals with the role and MFA status?
deploy-bot: @channel Automated check: release role holders:
• alice.h — MFA enrolled
• ben_k — MFA enrolled
• marco — MFA pending (recovery sent)
• ci-service-sa — service account (no MFA)
• ops-backfill — emergency backfill group (members: chloe, secops)

Note: service accounts cannot perform interactive presses — must use delegated human.
chloe: secops, can you confirm if ops-backfill members can be temporarily elevated for this window?
secops: short answer: we can grant a 1-hour JIT elevation for chloe, but policy requires at least one fully enrolled principal monitoring the deploy. If marco can't MFA, we need someone else who is enrolled to be present.
ben_k: ok. I can be the monitoring principal for the window. chloe — can you take the backfill elevation + be on watch?
chloe: yes I can. Requesting JIT now.
secops: granted JIT to chloe for 60 minutes. Audit note: elevation id 0x8f3a. Please acknowledge.
chloe: ack. I have the elevation and am on standby. Marco — please avoid trying to press until your key is replaced.
marco: will do. Thanks.
alice.h: Also a reminder to pin the release to 0.32.0-rc3 on the deploy bot so automatic fallback uses the verified artifact. Runbook excerpt:
```
# fallback procedure
1) abort ongoing push
2) pin deployer to 0.32.0-rc3: deploy-bot pin --release 0.32.0-rc3
3) trigger rollback job: deploy-bot rollback --to 0.32.0-rc3
```
ben_k: quick q — who has rights to run `deploy-bot pin`? service accounts?
alice.h: Only human principals with release-press + pin-perm. That's why we keep at least two fully enrolled humans.
secops: noted — logging will capture the actor. If anyone needs an exemption (e.g., emergency breakglass), file ticket immediately and include justification.
chloe: all set on my end. I tested the pin command in staging. If we see >10% error rate after the first 10m, we abort and pin.
marco: thanks all — I'll stay reachable but won't press. Sorry for the hassle.
alice.h: thanks. Agree we should avoid exemptions unless absolute emergency. Proceeding with the window. :thumbsup:
